attempts.sql: SELECT s.kind AS kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.is_public AND NOT f.is_test AND f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/tests/%' AND s.kind IN ('class','function','method') AND s.qualname NOT LIKE '%._%' AND (s.kind <> 'function' OR s.qualname NOT LIKE '%.%') AND (s.kind <> 'class' OR s.qualname NOT LIKE '%.%') GROUP BY s.kind ORDER BY s.kind

request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
explanation: Counts public symbols in non-test files under auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/, excluding its tests/ folder. It keeps classes, module-level functions (qualname without a dot) and methods, and relies on is_public to exclude underscore-prefixed names and members of private classes. Results are grouped by kind.
sql: SELECT s.kind AS kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.is_public AND NOT f.is_test AND f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/tests/%' AND s.kind IN ('class','function','method') AND s.qualname NOT LIKE '%._%' AND (s.kind <> 'function' OR s.qualname NOT LIKE '%.%') AND (s.kind <> 'class' OR s.qualname NOT LIKE '%.%') GROUP BY s.kind ORDER BY s.kind
